lines.text: Oh. You are not on the roster. Per the permit I should ask you to leave. I am asking. Quietly.
I am Aruun. This is my homeland.
Yes. I read about the homeland clause. It is in section nine. Nobody reads section nine.
The beetles. They keep throwing themselves at the pylons. I was told to keep them out of the dig. I do not know how.

choice.text: Tell me what you have seen. I will listen first.
Your pylons are hurting them. I can report that to the Dominion for you.

lines.text: ...Thank you. It is the hum. They run toward it and then they cannot stop.
Please do not. The report is how I lose this post. I would rather lose it for a reason.
